FAQ.lead: Answers to everything that comes up before you start. Didn't find your question?

items.a: No. The courses are built so anyone can start from zero — step by step, with practical examples and no programming.

items.q: How soon can I expect first results?
items.a: On average students find their first client within 2–4 weeks of starting, if they follow the structure and apply what they learn.

items.q: How much time per week do the courses take?
items.a: 4–6 hours a week is usually enough to see real progress — you can learn at your own pace.

items.q: How will I find my first clients?
items.a: The course has a dedicated section on finding clients — the steps, message templates and real examples you can use right away.

items.q: Can I study alongside work or university?
items.a: Yes. The platform is built for a flexible schedule — all materials stay available and you can learn at any time.

items.q: What happens after I finish the course?
items.a: You stay in the community, keep access to the materials and get support as you keep growing your service.

items.q: What if something doesn't work out?
items.a: Mentors and the community are with you at every step — ask questions and get concrete help, not generic advice.
